sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Confirm regional roofing sense of limahoya/valley and French noue with a qualified trade reviewer; the source speaks about water flow at the valley, not a generic roof edge.

The source names an ice-and-water shield in the English row but Spanish says membrana impermeable. Archived French specifies water-and-ice protection. Confirm product and membrane scope before scoring or recording a placement command.
Spanish gotera and English leak may mean a roof leak, water ingress or a dripping point. Archived fuite may be broad; choose the contextual dictionary sense.
Flashing/tapajuntas and asphalt shingle/teja asfáltica require contextual trade senses. Archived solin and generic bardeau may omit the asphalt modifier or vary by region.

The source directs peeling the backing paper and pressing membrane flat against the deck. Confirm adhesive/backing and substrate terms and approved product method before treating the imperatives as work instructions.
The source says cut membrane to length, but does not state a measured length or width. Keep archived bonne longueur conditional until plan/product detail is checked.

The source asks whether the entire valley is covered and to show protection before covering it. Archived entièrement protégée could imply protection quality rather than complete coverage; align the question and speaking objective with the source. Archived speaking also adds the product sheet and approved details.
